description: Checks each person in a campaign's audience for whether the campaign fits them, as confirming the count-and-cost prompt does, and holds back anyone it does not fit, with the reason. action read runs the check (it spends a short AI read per person; the answer says how many people and the estimate); action include or undo_include with clientId keeps or releases one person over the check. Nothing is sent: fit only decides who may enroll. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat returns the first answer.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: campaign_fit_read
title: Check who fits a campaign, and keep or release one person
